label: Separate form orientation from an appetitive principle
summary: An intelligible form and apprehended good can be populated while the form-relative orientation fails in the finite contemplator. Where orientation holds, the q.80 soul-power calibration still demands more than a primitive inclination. See docs/intellectual-appetite-source.md#intellectual-appetite-willing-and-self-operation-2026-11-26.
blocker: Show that orientation answers to the good as apprehended rather than following a natural form independently of apprehension.
